patch_description: The failure came from a stale/inconsistent SEARCH block (the _polish signature appears to already have been partially updated). To stay safe, I now propose a single, self-contained edit using text guaranteed to exist in the original current program: insert a scipy-based top-k softmin refinement stage (exactly the recommendation — log-sum-exp over only the k=20 smallest triplet areas with temperature annealing, softmax barycentric parametrization for guaranteed feasibility) right before `heilbronn_triangle11`, and wire it in as a final refinement applied to the best candidate found by the multi-start search. This is the part that most directly targets the primary objective, and it's independent of the state of the other helpers (all `_min_area(pts)` calls without idx remain valid since idx is optional).
